ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white) pixel distribution; dark pigmentation is concentrated at the fluke base and central region, while white pigmentation dominates the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone bifurcates towards the trailing edge; high-intensity white regions occupy the outer 60% of both lobes, featuring scattered low-intensity focal spots and complex mottling near the dark-to-light transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees at the vertex, transitioning into a wider U-shape at the posterior margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the distal tips, characterized by sharp, saw-toothed variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward-sweeping convexity along the leading edge; the trailing edge displays a slight concavity immediately lateral to the median notch before curving into the serrated distal lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters; primary cluster of 6-8 rosettes on the upper-right white lobe, and a secondary cluster of 4-5 on the mid-left white lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark central pigmentation, predominantly oriented diagonally from the base towards the outer lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of irregular, high-contrast pixel masses (consistent with barnacle colonization) located specifically at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
